primitive_imports.note: Primitives are imported, not owned: these are the ggml/llama entry points the ported code calls. They are counted per use site.

checks.implicit_check_detail: Scanned every fg* call in the copied sources against the declared set: one name looked undeclared, fg229i_try_fill, but it is a file-local C++ function defined at line 1829, above both call sites at 1850/1871 - not an implicit external declaration. Zero real implicit declarations.

size_contracts.model: LP64 (verified at generation time with ctypes on the build host)
size_contracts.arrays: passed as pointer + explicit length parameter; no implicit lengths, no owner transfer across the boundary
size_contracts.ownership: the caller owns every buffer passed as a pointer; modules neither allocate nor free caller memory
size_contracts.verified: return types are int(67)/int64_t(122)/void(2); parameters are scalars and pointers only, so no struct layout can drift

acceptance.criterion: all shared types have size/offset/import contracts; no implicit declarations; primitive imports separately inventoried
acceptance.result: no struct crosses the ABI (returns int/int64_t/void, parameters scalars and pointers), sizes verified on the host, arrays carry explicit lengths, caller owns all buffers; 165 typed declarations and 0 implicit; 948 primitive entry points inventoried with use sites
